title: Caption cue layout (plain JS for an HTML page)
what_it_does: Pure JS that turns word timings into caption cues: 2 lines of 42 characters (Netflix timed-text rules), cues held half a second past the last word, small gaps closed, at most two emphasised key words, fitted to the element width. The look stays in the page's CSS.
when_to_use: Captions on any HTML composition, including HyperFrames.
why: Apache-2.0; written as plain source on purpose so it can be injected into a page. It expects the open-edit page clock (__seek), so it needs a small adapter to HyperFrames' GSAP timeline.
